mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 72 degree temperatures with partly cloudy skies at Fireman's Park, a waning crescent moon, and an air quality index of 55.
City officials are currently reviewing development projects for South Main Street and are in the final stages of the student sticker design contest for the upcoming November election.

Today features trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead to tomorrow, enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmer's market, and additional trivia opportunities throughout the area.
During the week of August 3 to August 10, there were several notable calls, including an incident on August 8 where officers arrested a driver for O W I following a rollover crash.
Chocolate Heath Crunch is the flavor of the day. The store is currently closed, but you can stop by when they open at 10 AM to get your fix.
